disposition_mapping.rationale: Document retrieval carries no judgment and is automated by consensus, but the council (emerging_economy, pragmatist, finance_domain, agentic_architect, hitl_designer) converged that an automated assembly step must not silently proceed on an incomplete document set, since GRN/PO latency is routine in many delivery environments, not an edge case. TS-01 restructures assembly into an automated agent with an explicit data-gap exception path and a deferred-match holding state, preserving the KB-09 evidence-chain requirement that the PO-GRN-invoice triad remain individually identifiable rather than collapsed into an opaque match token.

Quantity comparison against the GRN is mechanical arithmetic that already executes inline with price and tolerance checks in modern matching engines; the baseline's own actor description (analyst 'with ERP matching engine') confirms this. It is merged into TS-02 on the unanimous condition, held by every council member who proposed consolidation, that quantity variance survive as a separately typed, line-level, independently retrievable output and that GRN data remain a consumed input, satisfying TWM-R-01 and TWM-R-03 without pretending a human checkpoint exists where none does.

Price/terms/tax comparison against the PO is likewise mechanical and merged into the same engine pass as quantity and tolerance logic, on the same condition: price and terms variance detail remains a separately typed, inspectable output and PO data remains an explicit consumed input, satisfying TWM-R-02 and TWM-R-04. Finance_domain's and hitl_designer's requirement that merged evidence stay tagged by category (so exceptions route to procurement vs. warehouse vs. tax) is adopted as a mandatory output schema element.

Pragmatist conceded in round 2 that forcing tolerance evaluation into a standalone workflow box when real ERPs evaluate tolerance keys inline with quantity/price comparison manufactures a fictional handoff. The synthesis follows finance_domain and agentic_architect: tolerance evaluation merges into the single engine pass of TS-02, with the tolerance policy preserved as an explicit, versioned, human-owned input and the clean/tolerance/exception classification preserved as a distinct, inspectable output, satisfying TWM-R-05 and TWM-R-06. Policy governance is protected by the policy's own versioning and change-log, not by an artificial step boundary - resolving the governance-vs-execution-boundary conflict in favour of output-level, not step-level, protection.

This is the council's central fork, and the synthesis sides decisively against maximalist's agentic auto-resolution tier, which maximalist itself conceded in round 2 after near-unanimous objection from pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards and emerging_economy: an un-reviewed engine disposition of an exception is suppression, not correction, under KB-05, regardless of how 'patterned' the exception appears, because patternedness is a claim about frequency, not about whether a recognised cost or liability figure is affected (KB-09, KB-11). TS-03 adopts the converged copilot mechanism instead - the agent drafts and ranks, a named human analyst (materiality-tiered to senior analyst/AP accountant for high-value cases) finalises every single disposition, and the recommendation and decision are logged as distinct artefacts. This satisfies TWM-R-10 while giving the analyst richer, pre-digested information rather than deskilling or displacing them.

The synthesis adopts the tiered, recallable auto-release gate (agentic_architect's mechanism, accepted by hitl_designer and pragmatist) for genuinely clean, no-exception matches, because uniform supervisor review of every clean invoice is a documented fatigue-driven rubber-stamp failure mode, not a stronger control. But it sides with hitl_designer, finance_domain and accounting_standards against bundling exception-resolved or tolerance-overridden matches into that same batch path: anything that required TS-03's judgment, by definition, means mechanical controls alone were insufficient, so it requires mandatory, individualised human sign-off with full evidence visibility - not a status flag - before release. This satisfies TWM-R-07, keeps exception resolution strictly before release (TWM-R-08), and the supervisor role is enforced as a distinct system credential from the TS-03 analyst role (TWM-R-09), treating that separation as a mechanism requirement, not a procedural convention, per emerging_economy's and agentic_architect's shared point.

This function is unconstrained by design, and the council used that latitude in different directions: maximalist proposed eliminating the periodic, human-reviewed report entirely in favour of pure query-on-demand telemetry. The synthesis rejects that extreme - pragmatist, hitl_designer, finance_domain and emerging_economy independently converged that a standing surface nobody is required to look at on a schedule is a control in name only. TS-05 keeps continuous, full-detail logging (a genuine strengthening over periodic batch reporting) but restores a named, mandated periodic human review and sign-off point, and - per emerging_economy's repeatedly-held point - keeps the report available in a basic exportable format so the control does not silently degrade in sites without premium BI/analytics tooling.

steps.actor: Automated integration agent (ERP connector), with AP analyst oversight of flagged gaps
steps.description: An automated ERP/integration agent assembles the invoice, purchase order and goods receipt note into a single match record the moment a validated invoice reaches the AP queue. The agent does not proceed silently on a partial set: where a PO or GRN cannot be located, is incomplete, or has not yet posted (a routine condition in some delivery environments, not merely an edge case), the agent raises a named data-gap condition and routes it directly into exception investigation rather than stalling invisibly or defaulting to auto-reject. Every retrieval is logged with source record identifiers.
steps.name: Automated match dataset assembly and completeness check
outputs: Deferred-match holding state record (for latent/asynchronous GRN or PO posting)

steps.actor: Deterministic matching/tolerance rules engine (system-executed), governed by AP controller/policy owner; AP analyst monitors output
steps.description: A deterministic, version-controlled rules engine executes quantity comparison against the goods receipt note, price/terms/tax comparison against the purchase order, and tolerance classification in a single computational pass, reflecting how modern matching engines already execute these as one transaction rather than three human-paced handoffs. The step boundary moves, but the evidentiary substance does not: quantity variance, price/terms variance, tax-treatment variance, and (where PO and invoice currencies diverge) an exchange-difference amount all remain separately typed, line-level, independently retrievable outputs feeding exception routing, never collapsed into an undifferentiated pass/fail flag. The tolerance policy is consumed as an explicit, versioned, human-owned input, and the resulting classification is logged together with the policy version that produced it. The engine remains inspectable deterministic logic; any statistical or ML-based scoring sits alongside, never inside, this classification.
steps.name: Automated three-way match, typed variance detection and tolerance classification
outputs: Price and terms variance detail (typed, line-level)

steps.actor: AP analyst (AI copilot-assisted), escalating to senior analyst/AP accountant for material or complex exceptions
steps.description: Every exception-classified match and every data-gap condition is investigated by a named, accountable human analyst, regardless of how routine or pattern-matched the discrepancy appears. An AI copilot may cross-reference vendor correspondence, historical resolutions and a documented, versioned resolution playbook to draft a proposed root cause and resolution, and materiality tiering routes high-value or high-complexity cases to a senior analyst or AP accountant, but the copilot never finalises a disposition: the analyst reviews the typed variance detail and the agent's recommendation, and records the final accepted/corrected/rejected decision as their own. The agent's recommendation and the human's actual decision are logged as distinct, separately attributable entries, and the full resolution evidence is captured verbatim (including under low-bandwidth/offline conditions via local capture with asynchronous sync) so it can be reconstructed later without summarisation or suppression.
steps.name: AI-assisted exception investigation and resolution
outputs: Resolved match (accepted, corrected or rejected), attributed to a named human
AI recommendation log (distinct from the human decision)

steps.actor: AP supervisor (system-enforced distinct role); automated release gate for clean/in-tolerance, no-exception matches
steps.description: Matches with no tolerance breach and no exception history are released through a policy-gated, system-enforced auto-release path: the action is logged, timestamped, attributable to the governing policy configuration, recallable up to the payment-run cutoff, and subject to periodic supervisor audit sampling. Any match that passed through exception resolution or a tolerance override is excluded from auto-release and requires mandatory, individualised human sign-off by the AP supervisor, who must view the actual resolution evidence and variance detail, not a status flag, before authorising release. The supervisor role is enforced as a distinct system credential from the analyst role in TS-03, so the same actor can never both resolve and release the same invoice.
inputs: Resolved match and verbatim resolution evidence
steps.name: Tiered match release authorisation
outputs: Recallable auto-release log entries (reversible until payment-run cutoff)

steps.actor: AP accountant/controller (named periodic reviewer), with continuous automated monitoring agent
steps.description: Match outcomes, tolerance overrides, auto-releases and exception resolutions are logged continuously and in full detail (not summarised) as a byproduct of TS-02 through TS-04 executing, with anomalies such as override clustering by analyst or vendor surfaced as they occur. This strengthens rather than weakens the control, but it does not remove the human from the loop: a named AP accountant/controller retains a mandated, periodic review and sign-off obligation over match-rate and override statistics, because a continuously logged surface nobody is required to look at on a schedule is a report nobody reads with better tooling. The control record and periodic report remain available in a basic, exportable format usable without premium BI/analytics licensing, so the control is not degraded for sites without dashboard-tool access.
steps.name: Continuous match control monitoring and periodic control review
outputs: Periodic match-rate and override report (locally exportable, human-signed-off)
